general_information.Syllabus Name: Traditional Animation Principles_Thiết kế chuyển động hoạt hình
general_information.Description: Students will learn the principles and processes of animation by assuming the role of assistant animators, applying traditional drawing skills to create finished scenes from rough animation. Ink and paint skills will be introduced as students use digital and traditional tools to complete a short animation movie.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook and references in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment - Computer with sofware PS, AI, ID, Adobe After Effects, PR installed - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course
general_information.Tools: Tools: Learning tool requirements 1. School preparation: a) For each student - 01 light table b) To the studio: - Glass table - 01 projector 2. Students preparation: - Pencil, eraser, ruler, A3 paper. A4 - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Ps, Ai, Ae, Pr

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Knowing the role of motion in a cartoon.
Understanding how to create a motion in a cartoon
Drawing the basic walk and run cycle of people
Drawing an Ostrich walking and running
Drawing of the four-legged animal running (horse)
Complete a short animation movie with the materials collecting from the following subject: ANC, ANS, ANB.

assessments.Grading Guide: 1. Choose sound, music: 2 points 2. Apply VFX (If needed): 3 points 3. Edit: 3 points 4. Film credit: 2 points

Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. - Teacher gives marks on student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.
